ops.body: Round 1 complete: implementation done (store-free settleWithin ladder in proc/reaper.go; deferred background untrack via Manager.untracks WaitGroup drained in Shutdown; next-gen Recover reaps leaks; both acceptance tests verified falsifiable against pre-fix code; full suite/build/lint green). Finder+refuter review confirmed criterion (a) holds but surfaced 3 substantive findings now in a verify-and-fix round: same-tick-PID-reuse record aliasing vs deferred remove (breaks criterion b), one-shot-then-leak accumulation to ErrReceiptBacklog under permanently failing Remove, and old-remover vs successor-Recover Load→BeginReap race. Also flagged for the repin wave: Done()/Stop() no longer imply the durable record is gone (durability at Shutdown) — consumers reading the store immediately after settle must poll; sweep fusekit/cc-pool/synckit for the pattern during A4.
